coverage_notes.assessment: Twelve targeted searches and seven direct-source pages produced no newly source-verified, nonduplicate U.S. disruption in the four narrow recall classes since 18:46:08 PST. Search returned mainly older incidents, routine information and conditional (not actual) cancellations.
coverage_notes.limitations: Bounded search-index recall only, not exhaustive nationwide coverage. Source timestamps and in-hour post indexing can lag; provider pages show only current public notices. No claim that primary production has deduplicated or ingested any item.
coverage_notes.action_limits: One append-only heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger. No approval, publication, merge, schedule, or automation setting changes.
